Title: User Login
Body:
As an employee, I want to log in to the POS system so that I can access authorized features.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Given valid employee credentials, when I log in, then I can access the POS interface.
- [ ] Given invalid credentials, when I try to log in, then an error message appears.
- [ ] A successful login identifies the active employee.

## Estimate
Proposed: 3 story points (confirm through team planning poker).

Title: View Menu
Body:
As a cashier, I want to view the menu so that I can find items and their prices.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The menu displays available items with names and prices.
- [ ] Each displayed item has a readable description.
- [ ] The cashier can view the menu without modifying menu data.

## Estimate
Proposed: 2 story points (confirm through team planning poker).

Title: Create Order
Body:
As a cashier, I want to add menu items to a new order so that I can prepare a customer checkout.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A cashier can start an empty order.
- [ ] A cashier can add one or more menu items to that order.
- [ ] The order shows each selected item and its subtotal before tax.

## Estimate
Proposed: 5 story points (confirm through team planning poker).

Title: Modify Order
Body:
As a cashier, I want to change quantities or remove items so that I can correct an order before checkout.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A cashier can increase or decrease a selected item quantity.
- [ ] A cashier can remove an item from the current order.
- [ ] The displayed order subtotal updates after each modification.

## Estimate
Proposed: 3 story points (confirm through team planning poker).

Title: Calculate Total
Body:
As a cashier, I want to see the subtotal, tax, and total so that I can tell the customer the amount due.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The subtotal equals the sum of line-item prices times quantities.
- [ ] The tax amount is calculated using the configured tax rate.
- [ ] The final total equals subtotal plus tax and is displayed to two decimal places.

## Estimate
Proposed: 3 story points (confirm through team planning poker).
